# Canadore College

> Canadore College is a comprehensive Ontario college offering diverse programs from entry-level to advanced training, with strong emphasis on student support, indigenous education, international pathways, and experiential learning.

Located in North Bay and Parry Sound, Ontario, Canadore College serves domestic and international students through various academic programs including aviation training, trades fundamentals, and professional development. The college prioritizes student success through integrated support services, accessibility initiatives, and community engagement.

## Key Topics

- Admissions and Registration
- International Students (PGWP)
- Student Support Services
- Indigenous Education and First Peoples' Centre
- Campus Life and Student Council
- Health and Wellness
- Experiential Learning and Work-Integrated Learning
- Entry-Level Programs
- Aviation Training
- Accessibility and Inclusion
- Orientation and Getting Started
- Campus Tours
- Student Residence Housing
- Volunteer Programs
- Winter 2026 Enrollment

- [Registration](https://www.canadorecollege.ca/get-started/registration): Student registration guide for Winter 2026 enrollment and class scheduling
- [Orientation](https://www.canadorecollege.ca/get-started/orientation): New student orientation information and welcome events for Winter 2026
- [Join Us - Campus Tours](https://www.canadorecollege.ca/experience/join-us): Campus tours and recruitment information for prospective students

## Academic Programs

- [Entry Level Programs](https://www.canadorecollege.ca/experience/entry-level-programs): Entry-level programs including General Arts and Trades Fundamentals
- [Experience Aviation](https://www.canadorecollege.ca/experience/experience-aviation): School of Aviation campus tour and flight training program overview
- [Experiential Learning](https://www.canadorecollege.ca/experience/experiential-learning): Work-integrated learning, student placements, and hands-on learning guide
- [Interprofessional Education](https://www.canadorecollege.ca/experience/interprofessional-education): Interprofessional education initiatives and collaborative learning programs

- [Health and Wellness](https://www.canadorecollege.ca/experience/wellness): Campus health services, dental clinic, and student wellness programs
